negative_results.claim: A statically valid effect summary is sufficient runtime authority.
negative_results.evidence: The effectful wrapper was statically closed but failed with EffectDenied when runtime permit was absent; it succeeded only with log.write explicitly present.

negative_results.claim: Checking only direct effects of each function is sufficient for compositional safety.
negative_results.evidence: Deleting an actually inferred transitive effect from a caller declaration was rejected across 20,000 randomized graph mutations with zero false accepts.

negative_results.claim: Recursive control can execute safely without an explicit resource/step bound at this stage.
negative_results.evidence: Deliberate runaway recursion was stopped only by the explicit step budget; candidate therefore keeps recursion resource-bounded.

negative_results.claim: Successful local control/effect closure is sufficient to pass any ClayCode BASE work package or release gate.
negative_results.evidence: No target Ubuntu execution, production compiler integration, lowering, target-reader benchmark or mandatory application proof was executed.
